name: io.github.ljcl/intervals-mcp
description: Remote MCP server for intervals.icu run data and analysis

environmentVariables.name: INTERVALS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: intervals.icu personal API key (Settings, Developer Settings)

environmentVariables.name: INTERVALS_ATHLETE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Athlete id; default 0 means the API key's own athlete

environmentVariables.name: TZ
environmentVariables.description: IANA time zone for local dates, e.g. Australia/Sydney

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret gating /mcp and detailed /health (recommended when internet-facing)

environmentVariables.name: PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public URL, used only to warn when /mcp is exposed without MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
